headline: Pass rusher Jaelan Phillips among four Panthers ruled out for TNF vs. Packers
summary: The Panthers ruled out four players, including starting OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee) for "Thursday Night Football."

headline: Sources: Colts' Josh Downs requests trade; Jonathan Taylor hasn't, per coach
summary: Colts wide receiver Josh Downs is requesting a trade amid the team's rebuilding efforts, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Wednesday.

headline: Derwin James could land on IR after hamstring setback
summary: The Chargers' bid to salvage their season may unfold without the assistance of safety Derwin James.

headline: Report: Texans expect Jaylin Noel to miss the rest of the season
summary: The toe injury that landed Texans wide receiver Jaylin Noel on injured reserve is likely to end his season.

headline: Jets WR Garrett Wilson says he doesn't want to be traded but does want to win
summary: Jets receiver Garrett Wilson says he doesn't want to be traded but he expressed that he's frustrated by his target share and, most of all, losing.

headline: Ravens list Lamar Jackson as full participant in practice
summary: Lamar Jackson was a full participant in Wednesday's practice for the Ravens.
